surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 19 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-A'laa (The Most High) is the 87th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 19 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سبح اسم ربك الاعلى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High
who created [all things] in due proportion
who determined their destinies and guided them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And who brings out the pasture
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who brought out the green pasture

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا ما شاء الله ۚ انه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We will ease you toward ease
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall show you the easy way

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So remind, if the reminder should benefit
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So remind, if reminding will help

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But the wretched one will avoid it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but it will be ignored by the most wicked

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who will enter the Great Fire

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: where they will neither die nor live

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Prosperous are those who purify themselves

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: remember the name of their Lord, and pray

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But you prefer the worldly life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet you [people] prefer the life of this world

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: All this is in the earlier scriptures

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses
